title: motd / IRC
prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing
Asset type: minimalist die-cut sticker artwork for motd, an Android IRC client. Flat 2D finished sticker only on a genuinely TRANSPARENT background.
Creative direction: punk / underground hardcore graphic DESIGN LANGUAGE only: stark two-ink silkscreen, strong condensed sans type, tiny amount of worn ink. Early constructivist influence solely through asymmetric typography and one simple diagonal accent. Contemporary IRC logo sticker, highly restrained and immediately readable at small size.
Subject constraints: only IRC chat symbols (slash commands, #channel symbol, chat bubbles, terminal cursor) and motd brand lettering. Zero people, crowds, fists, musicians, microphones, instruments, radios, antennas, cassettes, flags, political symbols, stars, propaganda scenes, scenic illustrations, bursts, collage layers or explanatory prose.

Materials: matte ivory sticker stock with black/red inks, very subtle silkscreen imperfections confined to printed shapes. Smooth clean die-cut boundary, a thin ivory border. Transparent outside sticker shape, no square background, no cast shadow, no photograph, no mockup, no hands. No extra sticker, watermark, caption, website or signature.
QR layout: a real machine-generated QR will be added afterward. Leave specified quiet area plain solid ivory, without any drawn fake QR, outlined placeholder, caption or decoration.
Shape: one perfectly circular ivory sticker centered on square transparent canvas, diameter exactly90% of canvas, bounds x5%-95%,y5%-95%.
Design: a single substantial black chat-bubble silhouette containing an ivory forward slash "/" centered in the upper half; one tiny red diagonal accent adjacent to bubble. Small bold lowercase "motd" wordmark centered below at about60% height. No other slogan or text. Minimal emblem, the black slash chat logo is the entire focal point.
Color palette: ivory, black, single vermilion accent.
Text(verbatim): "motd".
QR quiet area: centered near the bottom, rectangle x40%-58%,y72%-90%, completely plain ivory. Keep symbol and text entirely above68%height.
